title: Audit log
subtitle: Every state change is appended to a SHA-256 hash chain. Verify it to prove nothing was altered.
brokenHint: A stored row no longer matches its hash. Everything from this entry onward cannot be trusted.
hiddenBreak: The break is at seq {seq}, which is outside the entries visible to your account.
